title: Suits
summary: Suits are the lowest level minions of the Organization. Typically dressed in dark suits, they are the pawns whom the higher-level Organization operatives use to achieve their nefarious goals.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext: Most Suits were banded together by [[the Professor]], practically overnight, through the use of [[Araknos|Araknos']] mind control ability. {{source|The Secret of Two Generations}}
sections.text: Most Suits were banded together by the Professor, practically overnight, through the use of Araknos' mind control ability. [The Secret of Two Generations]

sections.heading: DeFoe's Suits
sections.text:
Image caption: DeFoe's Suits in the Cave of the Gargoyle

DeFoe had his Suits pursue Lok Lambert in an attempt to retrieve Eathon Lambert's journal and its secrets of the Amulet of Will. Three of them cornered him in the courtyard of Dante Vale's house but were defeated by Dante Vale. [A Seeker Is Born] DeFoe's Suits staked out Dante's house before chasing him and Lok through Venice. They were defeated with help from Sophie Casterwill and Santiago. Later, a large group of Suits attacked the Venice Huntik Library where they fought Dante and Santiago. In the midst of battle, however, the Huntik team were able to escape. [The Casterwill Client]

Pursuing the Foundation's clue regarding the Golem, the Organization sent Suits to infiltrate and attack the Prague Huntik Hotel. After DeFoe found Jodis Lore's Key, the Suits attacked the team again. However, despite gaining the upper hand, the Suits were forced to retreat when Lok arrived to turn the tables giving Dante time to recover the Amulet and summon Metagolem. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies]

Image caption: Two of DeFoe's French recruits

The team was later sent to Rouen, France, to retrieve Gar-Ghoul. [Into the River of Secrets] However, they missed the more important information on the Ring of Arc and were then sent by the Professor to Paris, France, following Dante's team into the Paris Catacombs. [Crawling the Catacombs] Despite gaining a number of new recruits from Paris, they were unsuccessful at retrieving the Ring. [Divide and Conquer]

His Suits were later sent after King Basilisk, but lost the Titan to Zhalia Moon. They also lost unnamed Suit 001 to a petrification trap within the Titan's chamber. [Absent Heroes] Upon this failure, DeFoe lost command of his original team of Suits and thus had to rally his remaining loyal Suits within Velo, Greece, in an attempt to finally get his revenge on Dante Vale. This team failed and were escorted back under Grier. [The Treasures of the Argonauts]

sections.heading: Grier's Suits
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S1E12 Grier's Suits.jpg|thumb|170px|[[Grier]]'s Suits]]
Upon taking DeFoe's place of leadership within [[the Organization]], [[Grier]] had his Suits accompany him to [[Sutos Island]] in order to reclaim the rulership of the island. The Suits were led into a trap by [[Lok Lambert]] and [[Sophie Casterwill]], and the two sides battled until [[Dante Vale]] and Grier announced a truce. His Suits were then permitted to help enforce order on Sutos in order to promote peace on the island. {{source|Like Father, Unlike Son}}
sections.text:
Image caption: Grier's Suits

Upon taking DeFoe's place of leadership within the Organization, Grier had his Suits accompany him to Sutos Island in order to reclaim the rulership of the island. The Suits were led into a trap by Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill, and the two sides battled until Dante Vale and Grier announced a truce. His Suits were then permitted to help enforce order on Sutos in order to promote peace on the island. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

sections.heading: Klaus's Suits
sections.text:
Image caption: Two of Klaus' Viennese Suits guarding his lab

Klaus' Viennese Suits were sent, under the instructions of Rassimov, to go after Dante Vale in County Kerry, Ireland. His team of Suits ambushed Scarlet Byrne and Dante's team in the New Grange Passage Tomb, using their powerful spells and Titans to gain the upper hand. However, they were eventually defeated after Sandra Lambert arrived, making a vital intervention. [Home Turf]

Image caption: Klaus and his Egypt Suits

Klaus sent his Egyptian Suits to excavate the tomb of Nefertiti, and both his Suit teams were sent after the Sceptre of Nefertiti, which was taken from the Foundation members after a skirmish. [The Sceptre Deception] During the mission to secure the Amulets of Vlad Dracul, three of his Suits were transformed through the power of Overmode. Even with this power, however, they were defeated when Zhalia Moon chose to side with the Huntik Foundation. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

sections.heading: Rassimov's Suits
sections.text:
Image caption: Rassimov and his Suits face Lok in Atlantis

DeFoe's former Suits were placed under Rassimov and given an improved arsenal of Titans. They were then sent by Rassimov to ambush Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill, who were working at a burger joint in Venice, Italy. The Suits were defeated by Lok and Sophie, who were joined by Zhalia Moon. [All Work and No Pay]

Two of the recruits from Paris, also formerly under DeFoe, were sent by Rassimov in an attempt to eliminate Sophie Casterwill and company. They failed to hinder the Foundation members, however. More of his Suits, who had infiltrated the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot, confronted the Foundation team but were swiftly defeated. [Memory Lane]

His Suits were then sent by the Professor to the coasts of Turkey in search for the Ring of Behemoth. Though two of his Suits were overpowering the native Amazons, they were defeated by Dante, Lok, and Sophie. Rassimov later joined his team, but the Suits were defeated Dante received the Ring of Behemoth from Zhalia Moon. [Ladies' Choice]

sections.heading: The Professor's Suits
sections.text:
Image caption: Alpha and Beta, the Professor's personal Elite Suits

The Professor and his two elite agents, Alpha and Beta, travelled to King Solomon's Mines on the trail of the Ring of Tao. [The Golden Asp] After entering the Mines, the Suits fought aginst the Huntik team and Montehue and Tersly. Despite overpowering the Foundation's forces, they were forced to retreat when Lok bonded with Tao. [To Be Together] The two agents later attacked Dante's house and left the team considerably injured and worse for wear. [The Secret of Two Generations] They fought against the team at the Professor's castle but were defeated. [The Divine Comedy]

Following the Professor's defeat, the two agents attacked the Huntik team after they broke into Organization central but were defeated. [Doorway to Huntik]

Under the command of Wilder and Hoffman, the two agents defended the Professor's castle from Dante and Grier before being defeated. [An Ally from the Organization]

sections.heading: Wilder's Suits
sections.text:
Image caption: Wilder's Suits attack

A new team of six Suits was banded together by Mr. Wilder and sent to Peru, in order to destroy the Huntik team so that Wilder could become the new leader of the Organization. [Doorway to Huntik] The Suits helped Wilder take over Tower of Nostradamus and take Peter, Billie and Annette hostage. [The Tower of Nostradamus] Wilder's Suits travelled to Avalon where they fought the Huntik team and LeBlanche. [Knight of the Willblade]

When Lok and Sophie broke into the safehouse at the Golem's Attic on the Road of Alchemists, the Suits arrested them and attempted to transport them back to HQ. However, they were attacked by Dante, Zhalia and Lucas Casterwill's team, forcing them to retreat. [Chasing Void]

When the Huntik team launched an assault in Klaus' lab, the Suits fought against them, with one invoking a Redcap Titan, while two others lay in ambush with Stack. Later, two of them were ambushed by two Silent Soilders.[The Blood Spiral]

Image caption: Wilder's Suits attack the team at the Professor's castle

Two of Wilder's Suits attacked Sophie Casterwill in Hamelin, to get information about her. They overpowered her and Sabriel, with their new Titans, Shadow Agent and Doom Warden. However, as one of the Suit attempted to finish Sophie off with Stoneblade, Den and Cherit came in to save her.[Gremlow Infestation] The Suits were waiting on motorbikes to ambush the Huntik team as they landed in Baja California but were stopped by Dante, Lok and Den also on motorbikes. Later, two Suits fought the team in Hernán Cortés' vault, but retreated when Conquistador ran riot. [The Power of Umbra]

Wilder's Suits fought the Huntik team once again when they, guided by Grier, invaded The Professor's Castle, to recover the Professor's files on Rassimov. Four of them were defeated by Dante and Grier, wile the other two were defeated by Lok, Den and Cherit, while trying to stop the three of them from moving forward through the castle.[An Ally from the Organization]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.text:
Image caption: Mr. Mactavish invokes Redcap

The Suits' greatest asset is their sheer numbers, but they also make capable spies and are excellent at gathering information. In a battle, the Suits are trained to fight with a variety of spells and Titans. Just as the Organization brings about cold, unfeeling order with the help of savage evil deeds, its troops fight with Titans such as the cold Mindrone and the savage Redcap, and use the spell Augerfrost to knock their targets out cold.

Image caption: The Bonelasher/Enforcer pairing favored by Klaus' Suits

Many Suit teams fight using a conventional two-Titan combination, matching a ground-based frontline brawler with a ranged, aerial attacker, as seen with DeFoe and Grier's teams who often paired Redcap and Mindrone together. [S1E02] [S1E12] Klaus' Austrian Suits also followed this convention by primarily using Bonelasher and Enforcer together. Later on, Wilder's Suits returned to this formation by often using Venomaster and Gigadrone together. [S2E27]

Other Suit teams do not rely on this standard combination pairing. Rassimov's Suit team used a far more diverse range of obscure and dangerous Titans from across the Organization roster, a tactic which made them far more challenging and dangerous in combat. [S1E19] [S1E22] [S1E23] More elite agents, such as Beta, possess larger, more powerful Titans such as Terrapede. [S1E25] Some Suits' Titan rosters also very by region, with many Paris agents favoring the Titan, Jokoul. [Divide and Conquer] [S1E18] Klaus' Egypt team rely solely on multiple Sekhmet Titans along with Suit 030 invoking a single Ammit Heart-Eater. [S1E14]

sections.heading: Bonded Titans
sections.text:
Ammit Heart-Eater — TV Series — Used by Klaus' Egypt foreman, Suit 030, and a standard issue in Rassimov's squad; later used by Suit 025.

Bonelasher — TV Series — A common Titan for Suits under Klaus, Rassimov, Diaz and Wilder; historically used by The Professor's Personal Guard.

Dark Pharaoh — TV Series — A unique Egyptian Titan given to Suit 040 by Rassimov.

Doom Warden — TV Series — Wilder gave Suit 057 this Titan as a form of additional firepower.

Enforcer — TV Series — Mass-deployed under Klaus, Rassimov and the Professor for ranged and aerial combat; Wilder's Suit 054 also used one.

Gigadrone — TV Series — The primary source of aerial firepower for all of Wilder's Suits.

Impet — TV Series — A small gargoyle-like Titan used by Rassimov's Suits, and notably one of his spies in the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot, Suit 043.

Jokoul — TV Series — Standard issue Titan among DeFoe's Paris recruits and Grier's squad; also used in the Temple of Thor by Suit 012, and the elite Suit, Alpha.

Kopesh — TV Series — Kopesh Amulets were seen in the possession of Rassimov's Suits.

Mindrone — TV Series — The primary Titan for scouting and spying used across the squads of DeFoe, Grier, Diaz, and Wilder.

Nighlurker — TV Series — An ancient Egyptian Titan used by Rassimov's Suits.

Redcap — TV Series — The most common Titan of the Organization, often mass-summoned in battle; Used by the squads of DeFoe, Grier, Klaus, Rassimov, Diaz, and Wilder.

Sekhmet — TV Series — The primary Titan of Klaus' Egypt team and standard issue among Rassimov's squad.

Shadow Agent — TV Series — Wilder gave Suit 052 this Titan as additional firepower; later given to more of his most trusted agents in Japan.

Strix — TV Series — Used by DeFoe's squad, the elite Suit Alpha and the double agent, Ms. Moon.

Terrapede — TV Series — Used by the elite Suit Beta; awarded to up-and-coming agents who have shown promise in battle.

Unnamed Titan 003 — TV Series — Rassimov's Suits had the Amulet of a Swara-Titan equivalent of Forest Queen Diana in their possession.

Venomaster — TV Series — The main frontline brawler Titan for Wilder's Suits.

Gareon — adventure game — A chameleon ideal for espionage, used by Suits in the Adventure Game.

Derenzar — TCG — This extremely unruly Titan is used by Suit 008.

Kreutalk — TCG — Suit 004 possessed a Kreutalk much like her superior, DeFoe.

Neptunia — TCG — An aquatic water spirit used by the Suits for ocean-based operations.

Red Searcher — TCG — The Organization are known to deploy pairs of Red Searchers to scout ahead.

Slitherfang — TCG — A serpentine Titan used by Mr. Steel.

Tolivane — TCG — A Tolivane Titan is used by Charlene Hubbs.

Dervish — Comic — Diaz's Suits had a Dervish Titan amongst their roster.

Megladeath — Comic — Used by Diaz's Suits to fight in the water.
